# Automatos AI

> Expert AI agency and SaaS platform for building and deploying autonomous AI agents. Scaling intelligence, not headcount — multi-agent orchestration with agents, skills, playbooks, and a marketplace to run business operations end-to-end.

Automatos AI is a digital workforce platform where non-engineers can design specialised AI agents, connect them to real tools (Composio, APIs, workspaces), and launch them on sequential or parallel missions. Agents learn from outcomes, collaborate through a coordinator, and are governed by budgets, human-in-the-loop approvals, and full audit trails. Customers bring their own LLM keys (BYOK) or use platform credits.

## Product

- [Platform Overview](https://studio.automatos.app/): What Automatos does, who it's for, and how the digital workforce model differs from a chatbot
- [Auto & agents](https://studio.automatos.app/auto): Tell Auto what you need; it routes the work to a team of agents and brings back the result or the question
- [Command Centre](https://studio.automatos.app/command-centre): The board, calendar, questions, activity, governance and analytics for everything agents do
- [Documents & templates](https://studio.automatos.app/documents): Invoices, letters, reports and proposals rendered from one brand kit
- [Socials](https://studio.automatos.app/socials): A posting plan that makes each post on its day and waits for approval before it publishes
- [Your store & site](https://studio.automatos.app/your-store): The Shopify app and the chat and blog widgets for any website
- [Integrations](https://studio.automatos.app/integrations): Connect the apps you already use through your own accounts
- [Marketplace](https://studio.automatos.app/marketplace): Pre-built agents, skills, plugins, and workspace templates installable in one click
